name: droidlab-workspace
description: DroidLab - wireless Android test environment controlled from Windows

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-features
scripts.check: pnpm run check:registry && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:kotlin && pnpm run check:mutation && pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run test:protocol && pnpm run check:readme
scripts.check:kotlin-full: pnpm run check:kotlin && pnpm run check:kotlin-build
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check && pnpm run check:kotlin-build
